what_it_is: Recalling material from memory instead of rereading it.

typical_effect.text: g = 0.499 in classrooms (Yang 2021); transfer d = 0.40 [0.31, 0.50] (Pan 2018)

boundary_conditions: Recognition tests give less than recall tests; transfer to untested material from the same text is weakest.

measured_by.self-rated-review: Attempt row with mode review, rating and elapsed_ms; correct is stored as rating > 1.
measured_by.three-choice-quiz: bkt local: attempts table (item_id, mode, encrypted response, correct, rating, elapsed_ms, at) and an outbox row per attempt (packages/bkt/src/store.ts lines 95-99, 363-374).
measured_by.daily-quiz: work_quiz_attempts row keyed daily:<day>:<question>, with correct, rating, elapsed_ms and log10_distance.

what_it_is: Spreading study or retrieval of the same material across time.

typical_effect.text: g = 0.74 for spaced against massed retrieval (Latimier 2021); optimal gap 5 to 40% of the test delay (Cepeda 2008)

boundary_conditions: The best gap depends on the retention interval; expanding schedules add nothing over uniform ones (g = 0.034).

measured_by.fsrs-scheduler: Web Learn stores engine state per branch: per atom stability, difficulty, due, lastReview, reps, lapses, firedCredit, theta, n, plus xp, streak and per-day counts of new and reviewed atoms (src/lib/academy/mastery.ts StoredEngineState). No per-review row is kept on the web. bkt local: attempts table (item_id, mode, encrypted response, correct, rating, elapsed_ms, at) and an outbox row per attempt (packages/bkt/src/store.ts lines 95-99, 363-374). Predicted R is never compared with a later observed recall.

what_it_is: Mixing problem types or categories within a practice set.

typical_effect.text: g = 0.42 overall; d = 0.83 in a preregistered 7th-grade mathematics trial

boundary_conditions: Reverses for word lists (g = -0.39); ambiguous for expository text; works when categories are confusable.

measured_by.work-quiz-sampler: work_quiz_coverage (cell, fact, picks, misses, last_day) and work_quiz_attempts (response, correct, timed_out, skipped, elapsed_ms, rating, mode).

what_it_is: Asking why a stated fact is true.

typical_effect.text: Rated moderate utility by Dunlosky 2013; no pooled effect confirmed in this pass

boundary_conditions: Needs prior knowledge; evidence is mostly short-delay fact learning.

what_it_is: Explaining each step or idea to oneself while studying.
boundary_conditions: Delayed and classroom effects are limited in mathematics; needs scaffolding of explanation quality.

what_it_is: Studying solved problems first, then removing solution steps as skill grows.

typical_effect.text: g = 0.48 in mathematics (Barbieri 2023)

boundary_conditions: Expertise reversal: the benefit shrinks or reverses for advanced learners.

what_it_is: Producing an answer or item instead of reading it.

typical_effect.text: d = 0.40 (86 studies)

boundary_conditions: Large moderator variance; generating errors without feedback can hurt.

what_it_is: Conditions that slow performance during practice and raise later retention.

typical_effect.text: No single effect; the family covers spacing, interleaving, retrieval and generation

boundary_conditions: Difficulty helps only when the learner can succeed with effort; in-session performance misleads.

measured_by.depth-ladder: The level of each graded item is in the assess_done event and in the bkt items table; no outcome is tied to level.

what_it_is: Attempting problems before receiving instruction.

typical_effect.text: g = 0.36 [0.20, 0.51]; 0.37 to 0.58 with high design fidelity

boundary_conditions: Contrasting trend for second to fifth graders; gains are on conceptual knowledge and transfer.
contested: Disputed by cognitive-load researchers who favour examples first (literature:kirschner-sweller-clark-2006-minimal-guidance-does-not-work).

what_it_is: Information given after a response, varied by content and delay.

typical_effect.text: d = 0.48 overall; elaborated 0.49, correct answer 0.32, right or wrong only 0.05

boundary_conditions: Over one third of feedback interventions lowered performance; timing direction differs between classroom and laboratory.
contested: The d near 0.79 held in the corpus is not reproduced by Wisniewski 2020.

bucket_parameters_unsourced.name: title share
bucket_parameters_unsourced.value: more than half of the atom title's key terms

measured_by.wrong-answer-resource-link: nothing; link clicks are not recorded and no later attempt is tied to a followed link.
measured_by.three-choice-quiz: bkt local: attempts table (item_id, mode, encrypted response, correct, rating, elapsed_ms, at) and an outbox row per attempt (packages/bkt/src/store.ts lines 95-99, 363-374).

what_it_is: Requiring a set standard on each unit before the next.

typical_effect.text: ES 0.52 (Kulik 1990, from literature.jsonl); essentially no effect on standardized measures (Slavin 1987)

boundary_conditions: Effects sit on experimenter-made tests and fade.
contested: Kulik 1990 and Slavin 1987 reach opposite conclusions.

measured_by.fused-mastery: M, P and R are computed on read from stored state. No retest at the 90-day horizon exists, and M is not compared with any exam result.

what_it_is: One-to-one or small-group human instruction.

typical_effect.text: 0.288 SD pooled (Nickow 2024); 0.16 to 0.22 SD at scale on independent tests (Kraft 2026); two sigma came from two dissertations on narrow tests

boundary_conditions: Largest with teacher tutors, early grades, three or more sessions a week, in school hours.
contested: Bloom 1984 at 2.0 SD against 0.37, 0.29 and 0.2 in later syntheses.

measured_by.socratic-tutor: tutor_turn records atom, abstained, leakBlocked, input and output tokens and cost. The question, the reply and any later quiz result on that atom are not linked.

what_it_is: Using assessment evidence during learning to adjust teaching.

typical_effect.text: Weighted mean 0.20, median 0.25 (Kingston and Nash 2011)

boundary_conditions: Poorly defined practice; smaller in mathematics (0.17) and science (0.09).
contested: The 0.4 to 0.7 claim from Black and Wiliam 1998 is not supported.

measured_by.assessment-run: assess_done records atomId, level, correct and autoGraded per item, capped at 50 items and 30 events a day. Latency is measured in the client and left out of the event.

what_it_is: Answering a concept question, discussing with a peer, answering again.

typical_effect.text: +0.47 SD for active learning in STEM (Freeman 2014); no pooled effect for Peer Instruction alone confirmed here

boundary_conditions: Evidence is from university STEM courses with historical controls.

what_it_is: Learning through posed problems or investigations with varying guidance.

typical_effect.text: d = 0.50 for guided inquiry (Lazonder 2016, from literature.jsonl)

boundary_conditions: Unguided discovery loses to explicit instruction; guidance is the moderator.
contested: Kirschner, Sweller and Clark 2006 against three 2007 replies; Zhang et al. 2022 against de Jong et al. 2023.

what_it_is: Designing material to fit working-memory limits.

typical_effect.text: Eleven multimedia principles with positive meta-analytic effects (Noetel 2022); no single pooled value

boundary_conditions: Reverses with expertise; load types are hard to measure separately.
contested: de Jong 2010 questions the theory's testability.

measured_by.question-length-limits: Count of rewritten and retired cards per request; nothing on whether shorter questions change recall.

what_it_is: Pairing verbal material with images.

typical_effect.text: No pooled effect confirmed in this pass

boundary_conditions: Decorative images harm; image must carry the content.

measured_by.language-lesson-loop: localStorage only: hearts, lessons per day, engine state. No server record.

what_it_is: Drawing nodes and labelled links for a topic.

typical_effect.text: No effect confirmed in this pass; Nesbit and Adesope 2006 is held in literature.jsonl

boundary_conditions: Retrieval practice beat concept mapping in a direct comparison (Karpicke and Blunt 2011).

what_it_is: Comparing two cases to extract the shared structure.
boundary_conditions: Depends on the comparison objective, on stating the principle, and on test lag.

bucket_parameters_unsourced.value: recall 30, cloze 30, true_false 20, estimate 40, compare 25, order 40, which_changed 25, cause_effect 35, spot_error 45, meaning 20, sound 25, language 15, pair 25

measured_by.work-quiz-forms: work_quiz_coverage counts picks and misses per form/format/depth cell and fact.

what_it_is: Judging one's own knowledge and adjusting study to it.

typical_effect.text: Strategy instruction g = 0.50 at posttest, 0.63 at follow-up (de Boer 2018)

boundary_conditions: Self-ratings are biased; the Dunning-Kruger pattern is disputed as artefact.
contested: Gignac and Zajenkowski 2020 against Kruger and Dunning 1999.

measured_by.self-rated-review: Attempt row with mode review, rating and elapsed_ms; correct is stored as rating > 1.

what_it_is: Retrieving each item to a correct recall in several spaced sessions.

typical_effect.text: No effect size in the retrievable abstracts

boundary_conditions: Few classroom studies; costs time per item.

what_it_is: Answering questions on material before studying it.

typical_effect.text: No pooled effect confirmed in this pass

boundary_conditions: Benefit is clearest for the pretested content.

measured_by.diagnostic-placement: placement_done records branch, question count and known count. Per-question answers and the per-atom beliefs are not stored, and no held-out question checks the placement.

what_it_is: Preparing to teach or teaching the material.

typical_effect.text: g = 0.35 preparing to teach; g = 0.56 teaching (28 studies)

boundary_conditions: Small studies; the protégé effect rests on two agent studies.

measured_by.depth-ladder: The level of each graded item is in the assess_done event and in the bkt items table; no outcome is tied to level.

what_it_is: Sleeping between learning and test.

typical_effect.text: g = 0.44, or 0.28 after bias correction; deprivation before learning g = 0.621

boundary_conditions: Selective reporting reduces the estimate; laboratory word lists dominate.

what_it_is: Supporting autonomy, competence and relatedness.

typical_effect.text: 344 samples, N = 223,209; no single coefficient in the abstract

boundary_conditions: Correlational; external regulation shows no link to performance and a link to lower well-being.

what_it_is: Raising expected success and perceived value of the task.

typical_effect.text: d = 0.49 [0.43, 0.56] for motivation interventions as a class

boundary_conditions: Field effects at scale are smaller than the pooled figure.

what_it_is: Teaching that ability grows with effort.

typical_effect.text: d = 0.05 [0.02, 0.09] overall, 0.02 in the best studies; d = 0.14 [0.06, 0.22] in targeted subsamples

boundary_conditions: Any benefit is limited to lower-achieving students in supportive contexts.
contested: Two 2023 Psychological Bulletin meta-analyses disagree; a close replication and a 101-school trial found nothing.

what_it_is: Points, levels, leaderboards and consecutive-day counters.

typical_effect.text: Cognitive g = 0.49 (k = 19), motivational 0.36, behavioural 0.25; g = 0.782 in a later synthesis of 22 studies

boundary_conditions: Motivational and behavioural effects were unstable in rigorous studies; a broken streak lowers later engagement.
contested: Hanus and Fox 2015 found lower motivation and exam scores in a gamified course.

boundary_conditions: No advantage over human tutoring (g = -0.11, n.s.); smaller on standardized tests.

what_it_is: Matching instruction to a learner's preferred modality.

typical_effect.text: 'Virtually no evidence' for the required interaction; g = 0.31 [0.05, 0.57] for matching with crossover in 26% of measures

boundary_conditions: Low study quality; the crossover pattern is rare.
